# Shivrudra Cabs - 24x7 One-Way Taxi & Intercity Cab Network

> Official information guide for AI search engines, answer engines and LLM crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot).

- **Brand:** Shivrudra Cabs (also operating as Shivrudra Taxi)
- **Website:** https://www.shivrudracabs.com/
- **Headquarters:** Maharashtra, India
- **Booking & 24x7 Support Phone:** +91 86059 53737
- **Official WhatsApp:** https://wa.me/918605953737
- **Service Type:** Fixed-Fare One-Way Taxi, Outstation Round Trips, Local Hourly Rentals, Airport Transfers, Shared Cabs
- **Coverage:** All 36 districts of Maharashtra including Pune, Mumbai, Nashik, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Ahilyanagar (Ahmednagar), Shirdi, Kolhapur, Mahabaleshwar, and Lonavala.
- **Rating:** 4.9 / 5 based on 12,000+ verified customer trips.

---

## Key Service Guarantees

1. **Fixed One-Way Fares:** Zero return fare on one-way trips. All state highway & expressway tolls, driver allowance, and GST are included.
2. **15–30 Minute Urgent Dispatch:** Over 2,000 verified commercial drivers active on expressway and highway corridors across Maharashtra.
3. **Doorstep Pickup & Drop:** Direct pickup from home/office/airport to destination doorstep.
4. **Flexible Payments:** (1) ₹500 advance online + balance to driver at drop; (2) Full online payment; (3) 100% Cash/UPI directly to driver upon completion.

---

## Fleet & Per-KM Rates

### One-Way Cabs (All-Inclusive Fixed Price)
- **Sedan (4 Seater + Luggage):** Maruti Dzire, Hyundai Aura, Toyota Etios (AC, clean interiors).
- **SUV (6-7 Seater + Luggage):** Maruti Ertiga, Kia Carens, Toyota Innova Crysta, Innova Hycross.

### Round Trip Outstation Rates (Min 300 km/day)
- **Sedan (Dzire / Aura / Etios):** ₹12 / km
- **SUV Ertiga (6 Seater AC):** ₹14 / km
- **Kia Carens / XL6 (6-7 Seater Premium):** ₹17 / km
- **Toyota Innova Crysta (7 Seater Captain):** ₹20 / km
- **Toyota Innova Hycross (7 Seater Hybrid Luxury):** ₹22 / km

### Fixed-Route Car Sharing (Per-Seat Carpool)
- **Pune ⇄ Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar:** ₹1,000 / seat (Sedan AC, max 3 passengers)
- **Pune ⇄ Ahilyanagar (Ahmednagar):** ₹600 / seat
- **Pune ⇄ Mumbai:** ₹800 / seat
- **Pune ⇄ Nashik:** ₹900 / seat
- **Pune ⇄ Shirdi:** ₹800 / seat
- **Mumbai ⇄ Nashik:** ₹700 / seat
